# Historical Candle Fixtures

The fixture provider reads its files from `src/trading_scanner/fixture_data/`, packaged with the application, or from the directory named in `SCANNER_FIXTURE_DIR`. Each file declares one of these kinds:

| Kind | Location | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic` | `fixture_data/synthetic/` | Invented prices on fictional `SYN-` instruments. Generated by `scripts/generate_synthetic_fixtures.py`; do not edit by hand. |
| `chart_observation` | `fixture_data/observations/` | Chart-displayed readings from `specs/EXAMPLES.md` (also available through the compatibility link `docs/EXAMPLES.md`). Partial: only fully read candles are served, and nothing is filled in. |
| `provider_recording` | not yet present | Reserved for complete, reviewed provider exports. |

A future complete historical fixture must include its instrument identity, source, trading date, timezone, interval, source precision, complete required candle coverage, and approved expected analysis. Reconcile the Sun Pharma and Asian Paints drawing discrepancies before freezing exact numeric expectations.

Do not expand chart readings into supposedly real historical candles by guessing missing values. Synthetic data must stay explicitly labeled synthetic.
